about: C3 4th owner: not the same film - the good hands (src/scenes/tail/bot.js 'good', as virtual keys) drive phase a from the kerb four times, each try with its own draw (chase.trySeed: ?tailSeed=3, then 4, 5, 6), simulated without rendering (N.sim); prints the junctions he took each time and whether he was kept. The critic, 2nd look: three clean runs, his route identical to the metre. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_routes.json

steps.eval: (window.__route = () => { window.__tailFails = []; if (window.__routeN) G.scenes.go('tail', { beat: 'start', fade: 'cut', card: false }); window.__routeN = (window.__routeN || 0) + 1; const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; C.useBot('good', { seed: 7 }); C.autoBot = true; while (C.t < 110 && C.phase !== 'b' && !C.failing) N.sim(1); return JSON.stringify({ seed: C.trySeed, phase: C.phase, t: +C.t.toFixed(0), fails: window.__tailFails.map((f) => f.why), choices: C.driver.choices, way: (C.driver.allIds || []).join(' ') }); }, 1)
